Name: CM Rainy Days Fan-Song
Author: BritneyMc0206
Description:
[center][font=Times New Roman][size=5][b][i][u]This mod is OUTDATED[/u][/i][/b]
Please look to [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20965]CP Rainy Days[/url][/b] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/10252540]silvermoonchan[/url]﻿

Got permission from [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCjvrRp5J06REgUd91u8Xl3Q]Adam Haynes[/url] to use his song in a music/sound mod. This just adds his song to Rainy Days. Nothing else.

If any problems occur, please let me know.
Please be aware this is my VERY 1st attempt at a SMAPI mod, my 2nd attempt a mod in general, & a sound mod at that (not easy, is what I mean). It will take time to fix any problems while I'm still learning about it.

In respect to [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCjvrRp5J06REgUd91u8Xl3Q]Adam Haynes[/url], please get his permission before including this mod in a mod pack or using it in another mod. It's not my song to give permission to use.
I claim no ownership of anything in this mod. I simply wanted a song for the Rainy Days.

I hope everybody else enjoys this song as much as I have.
:3[/size][/font][/center]
